name: Marta Temido, Adam Jarubas - Article 1, alinéa 1, point 3; Directive 2001/18/CE – Article 24 septies – paragraphe 2 - Am 132
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2001/18/EC and 2010/53/EU as regards the placing on the market of genetically modified micro-organisms and the processing of organs
part_text: 2. The results of PMEM shall be used for the re-evaluation of GMMs upon renewal of consent, in particular to assess whether the assumptions of the environmental risk assessment remain valid: (a) Where PMEM identifies unforeseen environmental behaviour, including persistence in the receiving environment beyond the intended use, the GMM shall be subject to a reassessment of its environmental risks, and the monitoring plan shall be adapted or strengthened accordingly. (b) Where PMEM confirms the assumptions of the environmental risk assessment, the monitoring plan may be adapted in terms of its intensity and frequency, where scientifically justified, but monitoring shall not be discontinued for the duration of the authorisation.
